1062.description: A single-leg hip thrust with weight resting on your hips. It strengthens each glute separately and fixes side-to-side gaps.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

1126.description: A strap chest press with one foot lifted, adding a balance challenge to the pressing movement.
instructions: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

1190.description: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

1254.description: A bench press using resistance bands. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the band handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, pushing the bands away from your chest.
Slowly lower the bands back down to your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住带子手柄，间距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将弹力带推离胸部。
慢慢将弹力带放回到胸部，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
重复所需的重复次数。

1318.description: A cable row done on an incline bench so your torso is supported. It works the upper back and biceps without lower back strain.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle and attach a cable handle to the low pulley.
Sit on the bench facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the floor and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip and extend your arms fully in front of you.
Lean forward from your hips while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the cable handle towards your chest by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 以 45 度角设置一个上斜凳，并将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮上。
坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
从臀部开始向前倾，同时保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将电缆手柄拉向胸部。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉，然后慢慢伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1382.description: Calf raises with a stability ball held between your back and a wall. It works the calves while the ball helps you stay balanced.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1446.description: Holding the bottom of a Zercher squat with the bar in your elbows. It challenges the legs and core.
instructions: Place the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Hold the bottom position steadily.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then stand up.

1510.description: A reverse lunge where the back leg steps behind and across the line of the front leg. It trains glutes, thighs and balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.

1574.description: A seated machine squat with a wide stance. It puts extra emphasis on the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Set both feet wide on the platform with toes slightly out.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.

1638.description: A curl at a high pulley that begins with a pulldown. It builds the biceps and also the lats.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and slowly curl the bar down towards your thighs, keeping your wrists straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气，慢慢将杠铃向大腿方向卷曲，保持手腕伸直。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1702.description: A single-leg balance drill where you reach down to touch the floor or foot, training hip control and stability.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach down toward your foot or the floor.
Keep your back flat and your free leg extended behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

1766.description: A bodyweight leg curl on a lying leg curl station. Works the hamstrings with a controlled curl and slow lowering.
instructions: Lie face down on a leg curl machine with your legs extended and your ankles hooked under the padded lever.
Place your hands on the side handles of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在腿弯举机上，双腿伸展，脚踝钩在带衬垫的杠杆下。
将双手放在机器的侧手柄上以获得支撑。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1830.description: A forearm and elbow stretch for the small muscle at the back of the elbow along with the triceps. Useful after pressing or typing.
instructions: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1894.description: A standing wide-stance stretch for the inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.

1958.description: Pressing the tops of the toes against the floor to stretch the front of the foot and shin.
instructions: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2150.description: A side-lying clam with a band around the thighs that strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Lower the knee slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

2278.description: A decline-angle machine press that emphasises the lower part of the chest.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
Return slowly under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2342.description: A side-by-side form check for elbow position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2406.description: A reverse grip cable pushdown with an arm blaster. Targets the triceps with a different hand angle.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and slowly push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
启动你的三头肌，慢慢地向下推杠铃，直到你的手臂完全伸展。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2470.description: A rear delt raise performed lying face down on the floor. Targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your shoulder muscles, lift your arms up and out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在地板上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
调动肩部肌肉，将手臂向上并向两侧抬起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2662.description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

2726.description: Holding two heavy weights, arms out, for time to build grip and shoulder endurance.
instructions: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Hold your arms out to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders down.
Hold the position as long as you can.
Lower under control when done.

2790.description: Lifting the back of the hand up, working the top of the forearm.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2854.description: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

2918.description: Carrying a barbell off to one side with a single-handed grip. It trains your trunk to resist leaning and builds grip.
instructions: Stand with the barbell at your side and grip it near its center of balance.
Lift it while keeping your torso tall and level.
Walk with steady steps and resist tilting toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then lower the bar carefully.
Switch hands and repeat.

2982.description: A floor press where you press one dumbbell at a time. It trains the chest and triceps with a limited range for the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.

3110.description: A hip thrust with the bar on a Smith machine, giving a steady path to load the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3174.description: A bench press with your feet up and your knees bent to 90 degrees. This keeps your lower back flat and your trunk working.
instructions: Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.

3238.description: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

3302.description: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.
instructions: Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 找到一个有足够空间的空地来进行倒立。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿向上踢向墙壁，用核心和肩膀保持平衡。
处于倒立位置后，用三头肌来支撑体重。
只要能保持平衡，就保持倒立。
下降时，慢慢将双腿放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

3366.description: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3494.description: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3558.description: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

3622.description: Lift your legs and torso together to form a V, a demanding core move.
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.

3686.description: Move from a kneeling position to standing while holding a dumbbell.
instructions: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.

3750.description: Hop your feet side to side from a high plank for a core and cardio challenge.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.

3814.description: A front plank where you tap one foot out to the side at a time. It challenges core stability and hips.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Tap one toe out to the side and bring it back.
Repeat with the other foot.
Keep your body steady and avoid rocking.

3878.description: A jump squat with a band adding resistance for a more powerful leg drive.
instructions: Stand on a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Jump up explosively against the band.
Land softly through your toes and heels.
Sink immediately into the next squat.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

3942.description: A sit up done with your legs supported on a chair, which keeps the movement strict. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor and rest your lower legs on a chair or bench, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

4006.description: Arch back to stretch the front of the trunk. It lengthens the abs.
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press your chest up.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

4070.description: Bench press with a single board, shortening the range just a little. It builds pressing power near lockout.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a single board on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the board.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

4134.description: A step up holding a kettlebell, training each leg separately.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

4198.description: Drop off a box and hop over a hurdle.
instructions: Stand on a box.
Step off.
Land softly.
Jump over the hurdle immediately.
Land softly.
Reset.

4326.description: A pullover with the elbows kept bent, lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the chest and lats.
instructions: Lie back on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them bent throughout.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest and repeat.

4390.description: A reverse lunge with the barbell in a front rack. Stepping back keeps the load on the glutes and quads with less knee stress.
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and keep your torso upright.

4454.description: Seated rowing with a band and a wide grip. It works the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

4518.description: A front squat into an overhead press with one kettlebell. It combines legs and shoulders in one flowing move.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand in the rack position.
Squat down with your chest up and elbow close.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, repeat, then switch arms.

4582.description: A quick straight punch with your lead hand thrown at a heavy bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact.
Keep your rear hand guarding your chin.
Snap the punch back to your guard right away.
Stay light on your feet and repeat.

4646.description: A seated twist with your hands crossed on your chest. It trains the obliques and core rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Cross your hands over your chest.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

4838.description: A one-arm cable curl that keeps constant tension on the biceps. Train each arm on its own to even out strength.
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

4902.description: A one-legged hip thrust with the foot or upper back raised on a platform. It increases the range for the glutes.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and put one foot on the floor or a raised step.
Lift the other leg off the ground.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4966.description: An Olympic style drill where you press yourself down under a barbell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and speed.
instructions: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
Press up so your arms lock out.
Drop into a squat while keeping the bar overhead.
Keep your arms locked.
Stand up tall.
Keep your core braced.

5030.description: A push up combined with a jumping jack leg motion. It raises your heart rate while training chest and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet together.
Lower into a push up with control.
Push back up and jump your feet wide.
Jump your feet back together.
Keep your body straight and move rhythmically.

5094.description: Press the end of a landmine barbell with one arm. The angled path is shoulder friendly and challenges your trunk.
instructions: Anchor a barbell and hold the free end at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and core tight.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

5158.description: From a plank, slide your feet apart and together on towels. It works the core and hips without any impact.
instructions: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
Brace your core.
Slide your feet wide apart.
Slide them back together.
Keep your hips level and repeat.

5286.description: A forearm drill that rotates the hands through pronation, neutral and supination. It builds wrist and forearm control.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms hanging by your sides.
Bend your elbows and hold your forearms in front of you.
Rotate your palms down, then to neutral, then up.
Move slowly and keep your elbows still.
Repeat for several smooth rounds.

5478.description: Explosive lunge-and-drive-knee movement off a bosu ball that trains leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
Switch legs after your set.

5606.description: Prone swing with dumbbells to target the rear delts.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

5670.description: A deadlift with the bar cradled in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the glutes, legs and back and trains an upright torso.
instructions: Place the bar on a low rack or the floor and stand over it.
Squat down and hook the bar in the crooks of your elbows.
Lift your chest and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the bar back down under control, keeping your back flat.

5862.description: Curl a kettlebell with only your wrists while your forearm rests on your thigh. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

5990.description: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.
instructions: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

6054.description: A standing side bend with a bottle in one hand. It strengthens the obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

6438.description: A gentle pendulum swing for the shoulder joint. It loosens the shoulder and warms it up without any load.
instructions: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.

6758.description: A forearm rotation holding a dumbbell with the arm over the end of a bench. It trains the muscles that turn the palm up.
instructions: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

7206.description: A sideways step into a squat with band tension to train the glutes and legs.
instructions: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7590.description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8358.description: A bridge with the heels placed farther away so the hamstrings and glutes do more of the lifting.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

8614.description: A one-arm cable pushdown in a horizontal path, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

9318.description: Lying on the floor, you lower your straight body slowly for the dragon flag. A tough ab and core strengthener.
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

9510.description: A pull-up where a partner supports your legs or hips. It lets you build pulling strength while you work toward full reps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.

9702.description: A squat held low with small pulses, with your hands clasped at your chest as if holding a weight. It builds thigh endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.

10534.description: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.
instructions: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10598.description: A floor press throw with narrow hands. It builds explosive pushing power through the chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.

10662.description: A ring pull-up variation where you pull up, then press down toward the hips. It builds pulling strength and shoulder control.
instructions: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.

10854.description: A reformer arm circle holding straps. It works the shoulders and the upper back.
instructions: Lie on your back holding the straps with arms up.
Bend your knees and brace your core.
Lower your arms out to the sides.
Circle them down and up in a smooth arc.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Keep your ribs down.

10918.description: Another one-foot toe squeeze while seated. It strengthens the small muscles in the foot.
instructions: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

11878.description: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.
instructions: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

0038.description: A curl where the bar is dragged up along the torso with the elbows moving back. Targets the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the barbell up towards your chest by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，与手臂保持一定距离。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将杠铃向上卷曲至胸部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0102.description: A squat performed from a kneeling position with the bar on the back. Trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place a barbell across your shoulders, gripping it with an overhand grip and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your chest lifted as you slowly lower your body down by bending your knees, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将杠铃放在肩膀上，正手握住杠铃，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
收紧核心并保持胸部抬起，同时弯曲膝盖慢慢降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0166.description: A hammer-grip curl using a low cable. The neutral grip works the biceps and the forearm muscles together.
instructions: Attach a rope or handle to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your upper arms still and avoid swinging.

0230.description: A cable lift that sweeps the handle up and across the body with a rotating torso. It builds twisting core strength.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and position it at waist height.
Engage your core and maintain a straight back throughout the exercise.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the cable handle up towards your opposite shoulder, rotating your torso.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手握住电缆手柄并将其置于腰部高度。
在整个练习过程中启动核心并保持背部挺直。
保持手臂伸直，呼气并将电缆手柄向另一侧的肩膀向上提起，同时旋转躯干。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0294.description: The standard standing dumbbell biceps curl. You curl both weights up while keeping the upper arms still.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0358.description: Forearm on a bench or thigh, palm down, you curl the dumbbell up with your wrist. It builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on your thigh, with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards the ground by flexing your wrist.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly curl your wrist back up towards your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，正手握住，手掌朝下。
将前臂放在大腿上，手腕悬在边缘。
弯曲手腕，慢慢地将哑铃降低到地面。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢地将手腕向上卷向身体。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0422.description: Standing beside an incline bench, you curl one dumbbell with the upper arm braced on the pad. It keeps the biceps working without swing.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing forward.
Place your other hand on an incline bench for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手掌朝前。
将另一只手放在倾斜的长凳上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0486.description: A hip bridge that lifts the hips off the floor from a lying position. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your arms at your sides.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.

0550.description: You squat with a kettlebell at your chest, then stand and press it overhead in one motion. A full body move for legs and shoulders.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands, palms facing each other.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the kettlebell overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top of the movement, fully extending your elbows.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by reversing the movement, bending your elbows and lowering the weight back to your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手将壶铃放在胸前，手掌相对。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，保持挺胸、背部挺直，进入蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地通过脚后跟站起来，同时将壶铃压过头顶。
在动作的最高点锁定你的手臂，完全伸展你的肘部。
通过反转动作，弯曲肘部并将重量放回胸部，将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0614.description: Lying face down, you lift one leg at a time. It strengthens the glutes and the muscles along your lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides or under your forehead.
Keep your legs straight and your hips pressed down.
Lift one leg off the floor while squeezing your glute.
Lower it with control.
Lift the other leg and alternate.
Avoid arching your lower back.

0678.description: A pull-up bar move that mixes a pull-up with a controlled pulldown. Builds the lats, upper back and arms.
instructions: Stand in front of a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在引体向上杆前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
向上伸手，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0742.description: On a sled, you raise your heels with the machine angled forward. Works the calves.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整到舒适的重量，然后将自己放在机器上，脚趾放在平台上，脚后跟悬空。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面上以获得支撑。
收紧小腿，慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，克服雪橇的阻力。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0806.description: A push-up with the hands in suspension handles, so the body has to stay stable. It trains the chest, shoulders, triceps and core.
instructions: Find a suspension trainer and adjust it to an appropriate height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with an overhand grip.
Walk your feet forward, leaning your body forward until your weight is supported by the suspension trainer.
Keep your body straight from head to heels, engage your core, and lower your chest towards the handles.
Push through your chest and arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 找到一个悬挂训练器并将其调整到合适的高度。
背对锚点站立，并用正手握住手柄。
双脚向前走，身体向前倾斜，直到悬架训练器支撑您的体重。
保持身体从头到脚跟伸直，核心部位收紧，胸部朝手柄方向降低。
推动你的胸部和手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0870.description: A lying move where the hips lift off the floor as the knees come toward the chest. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides, palms facing down.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
At the top of the movement, squeeze your abs and pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在动作的最高点，挤压腹肌并暂停片刻。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0934.description: Pull a band up along your body toward chest height. It works the shoulders and upper traps with gentle, joint-friendly resistance.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends with both hands.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with the band slightly taut.
Pull your hands up along your body, leading with the elbows, until they reach about chest height.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without letting the band snap back.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders away from your ears.

0998.description: A triceps extension with a band, extending the arms out to the sides. It works the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, keeping them parallel to the ground.
Slowly bend your elbows and bring your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arms back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带，掌心朝下。
将手臂伸直至两侧，保持与地面平行。
慢慢弯曲肘部，将双手放在肩膀上，保持上臂不动。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
